verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 47.23
verses.english: Linked Discourses 47.23

verses.pali: 3. Sīlaṭṭhitivagga
verses.english: 3. Ethics and Duration

verses.pali: Parihānasutta
verses.english: Decline

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ āyasmā ca ānando āyasmā ca bhaddo pāṭaliputte viharanti kukkuṭārāme.
verses.english: At one time the venerables Ānanda and Bhadda were staying near Pāṭaliputta, in the Chicken Monastery.

verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmā bhaddo sāyanhasamayaṁ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṁ sammodi.
verses.english: Then in the late afternoon, Venerable Bhadda came out of retreat, went to Venerable Ānanda, and exchanged greetings with him.

verses.pali: Sammodanīyaṁ kathaṁ sāraṇīyaṁ vītisāretvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho āyasmā bhaddo āyasmantaṁ ānandaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When the greetings and polite conversation were over, he sat down to one side and said to Ānanda:

verses.pali: “ko nu kho, āvuso ānanda, hetu, ko paccayo yena saddhammaparihānaṁ hoti?
verses.english: “What’s the cause, Reverend Ānanda, what’s the reason why the true teaching declines?

verses.pali: Ko nu kho, āvuso ānanda, hetu, ko paccayo yena saddhammaaparihānaṁ hotī”ti?
verses.english: And what’s the cause, what’s the reason why the true teaching doesn’t decline?”

verses.pali: “Sādhu sādhu, āvuso bhadda.
verses.english: “Good, good, Reverend Bhadda!

verses.pali: Bhaddako kho te, āvuso bhadda, ummaṅgo, bhaddakaṁ paṭibhānaṁ, kalyāṇī paripucchā.
verses.english: Your approach and eloquence are excellent, and it’s a good question.

verses.pali: Evañhi tvaṁ, āvuso bhadda, pucchasi:
verses.english: For you asked:

verses.pali: ‘ko nu kho, āvuso ānanda, hetu, ko paccayo yena saddhammaparihānaṁ hoti?
verses.english: ‘What’s the cause, what’s the reason why the true teaching declines?

verses.pali: Ko panāvuso ānanda, hetu, ko paccayo yena saddhammaaparihānaṁ hotī’”ti?
verses.english: And what’s the cause, what’s the reason why the true teaching doesn’t decline?’”

verses.pali: “Evamāvuso”ti.
verses.english: “Yes, reverend.”

verses.pali: “Catunnaṁ kho, āvuso, satipaṭṭhānānaṁ abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā saddhammaparihānaṁ hoti.
verses.english: “It’s because of not developing and cultivating the four kinds of mindfulness meditation that the true teaching declines.

verses.pali: Catunnañca kho, āvuso, satipaṭṭhānānaṁ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā saddhammaaparihānaṁ hoti.
verses.english: It’s because of developing and cultivating the four kinds of mindfulness meditation that the true teaching doesn’t decline.

verses.pali: Katamesaṁ catunnaṁ?
verses.english: What four?

verses.pali: Idhāvuso, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṁ;
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant meditates by observing an aspect of the body—keen, aware, and mindful, rid of covetousness and displeasure for the world.

verses.pali: vedanāsu …pe…
verses.english: They meditate observing an aspect of feelings …

verses.pali: citte …pe…
verses.english: mind …

verses.pali: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṁ.
verses.english: principles—keen, aware, and mindful, rid of covetousness and displeasure for the world.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, āvuso, catunnaṁ satipaṭṭhānānaṁ abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā saddhammaparihānaṁ hoti.
verses.english: It’s because of not developing and cultivating these four kinds of mindfulness meditation that the true teaching declines.

verses.pali: Imesañca kho, āvuso, catunnaṁ satipaṭṭhānānaṁ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā saddhammaaparihānaṁ hotī”ti.
verses.english: And it’s because of developing and cultivating these four kinds of mindfulness meditation that the true teaching doesn’t decline.”

verses.pali: Tatiyaṁ.
